        # Test that the controller meets commanded pressure during the pressure fall phase
        # within an overshoot of 0.8*PEEP-1 cmH2O

        peep = 25  # as specified in the requirement
        overshoot = 0.8 * peep - 1
        self.assertLessEqual(commanded_pressure, overshoot)

    def test_meet_commanded_peep(self):
        # Test that the controller meets commanded PEEP within ±1 H2O + 10% (of what?)
        # We assume the percentage is of the commanded PEEP value
        commanded_peep = 20  # as specified in the requirement
        tolerance = 1 + (0.1 * commanded_peep)
        self.assertLessEqual(commanded_peep - tolerance, 0)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(commanded_peep + tolerance, 0)

    def test_target_fio2(self):
        # Test that the controller achieves target FiO2 value within 0.05
        target_fio2 = 0.21  # as specified in the requirement
        self.assertLessEqual(target_fio2, 0.21 + 0.05)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(target_fio2, 0.21 - 0.05)

    def test_fio2_measurement(self):
        # Test that the controller reports FiO2 as measured prior to patient inhale limb
        measured_fio2 = 0.22  # as specified in the requirement
        self.assertEqual(measured_fio2, 0.22)

    def test_air_conditions(self):
        # Test that the controller achieves commanded values under different air conditions
        # affecting air density, such as temperature, altitude and humidity
        commanded_pressure = 20  # as specified in the requirement
        self.assertLessEqual(commanded_pressure, 20)

    def test_assist_control(self):
        # Test that the controller implements assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation mode
        # where inspiration is triggered by detecting patient inspiration
        self.assertTrue(True)

    def test_safety_measures(self):
        # Test that the controller has safety measures to avoid acting on absurd commands
        # even in case of data corruption between GUI and controller communication
        with patch('controller.communication') as mock_communication:
            mock_communication.side_effect = Exception('Data corruption')
            self.assertRaises(Exception, self.controller.act_on_command)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

        self.assertGreaterEqual(mock_controller.get_current_pressure.return_value, 20 - 0.8 * 1)  # cmH2O
